'''Sam Waurie''' was the son of a famous [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Security Division]] executive.

==Personality and traits==
Sam never aspired to reach the height his father achieved, and instead worked in a series of dead-end jobs contentedly for many years, during the era of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. He showed great promise as a programmer, but chose to remain a drudge. He was a dreamer, and often found himself dreaming of heroic, romantic, melodramatic deeds.
